items.title: Edmond Hall Interview, 1957-04-11
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] George Blanchett, is that the fella you found? ... [INTERVIEWEE] I can't remember his name, but we had an agent, so I know that.

ctx.x: Yeah, we went on a tour. After we closed in Covington, we went somewhere in Alabama, Mississippi. We toured for a while. And I think you mentioned a fella that had something to do with us after we left Covington, Louisiana. It's a Covington Hotel over there.
George Blanchett, is that the fella you found? I don't know.
I can't remember his name, but we had an agent, so I know that.
